plugins.name: dsh-memory-plugin
plugins.zh: 整合长期记忆、知识检索与技能，为智能体提供自演进的上下文数据库。
plugins.en: Unifies long-term memory, knowledge retrieval, and skills into a self-evolving context database for agents.

plugins.name: deepseek-harness
plugins.zh: 将架构、流程、时序、数据流等图表生成能力打包为技能，输出带动效的自包含 HTML 并支持清晰导出。
plugins.en: Generates self-contained, motion-rich diagrams for architecture, workflow, and data-flow with crisp export, packaged as an agent skill.

plugins.name: modlens
plugins.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
plugins.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

plugins.name: coding-agents
plugins.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。
plugins.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.

plugins.name: DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。
plugins.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

plugins.name: dsh-agent-teams
plugins.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。
plugins.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一只住在 DSH 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘，帮你盯着DeepSeek账户余额。QQ弹弹，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用，建议直接喊来你的dsh安装
plugins.en: Adds an interactive whale character to the DSH interface that monitors account balance with animations.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-desktop
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态提供现代化桌面端解决方案，助力插件的开发与管理。
plugins.en: Provides a modern desktop solution for the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem, aiding plugin development and management.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-browserskill
plugins.zh: 通过 CLI 与扩展让智能体操控真实登录的浏览器，无干扰地自动化任务。
plugins.en: Enables AI agents to control a real, logged-in browser via CLI and extension, automating tasks without disruption.

plugins.name: dsh-cost-meter
plugins.zh: 会话与当日 API 费用统计、预算图框（已用%）、官方余额、历史看板，支持峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。
plugins.en: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.

plugins.name: skin-center
plugins.zh: 作为 DSH 网页界面的皮肤中心，集中浏览与应用主题，简化管理。
plugins.en: Acts as a central hub for browsing and applying skins within the DSH web interface, simplifying theme management.

plugins.name: dsh-im
plugins.zh: 通过扫码或机器人凭据把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord和WhatsApp）。 Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials (8 channels).
plugins.en: Connects IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials across eight chat platforms.

plugins.name: dsh-weknora
plugins.zh: 将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理代理和自维护Wiki，用于知识管理。
plugins.en: Converts raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki for knowledge management.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin
plugins.zh: 提供隐私保护、可定制的简历构建工具，支持安全编辑与导出功能。
plugins.en: Builds privacy-focused, customizable resumes directly in the interface, offering secure editing and export options.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.zh: 管理DeepSeek Harness客户端插件，支持用户轻松安装、启用或移除扩展。
plugins.en: Manages client-side plugins for DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to install, enable, or remove extensions easily.

plugins.name: dsh-context
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加上下文洞察面板，展示模型上下文窗口当前的构成与演变过程：各部分占比与窗口大小对照、按请求的历史趋势、压缩与注入事件，以及消息级 token 统计。
plugins.en: Adds a Context Insight panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI showing what the model's context window currently holds and how it evolved: composition against wind

plugins.name: dsh-vision-router
plugins.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。
plugins.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots)

plugins.name: dsh-TUI
plugins.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。
plugins.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

plugins.name: dsh-community-plugins
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端提供任务看板、Git 图、实时令牌统计等界面插件集合。
plugins.en: Provides a collection of UI plugins for the DSH web client, including task boards, git graphs, and live token stats.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit
plugins.zh: 一键安装、免费使用；粘贴图片即可看图问答。为纯文本模型提供近乎无缝的多模态体验，支持图片问答、多图比较、长图 OCR、截图到前端 UI 还原、元素定位、像素对比等。
plugins.en: One-command install and free to use; paste an image to see and ask. Provides a nearly seamless multimodal experience for text-only models, supporting image Q&A,

plugins.name: dsh-doctor
plugins.zh: 为DSH网页界面添加任务板、Git图、右侧面板、远程移动UI、宠物、实时Token统计和皮肤中心。
plugins.en: Adds task board, git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center to the DSH web interface.

plugins.name: modsearch
plugins.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。
plugins.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

plugins.name: dsh-pocket
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）
plugins.en: Lets users access their local DeepSeek Harness web instance from a phone via QR code, syncing over LAN or public network.

plugins.name: dsh-genui
plugins.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。
plugins.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.

plugins.name: dsh-market
plugins.zh: 渲染创意工坊界面，供用户发现并安装社区插件。
plugins.en: Renders a marketplace interface for discovering and installing community plugins.

plugins.name: anysearch-dsh
plugins.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供网络搜索和高级搜索工具，增强信息检索能力。
plugins.en: AnySearch web search provider and advanced search tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

plugins.name: dsh-skin-market
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供皮肤市场，可能提供主题皮肤以自定义外观。
plugins.en: Provides a skin market for DeepSeek Harness, likely offering theme skins for customization.

plugins.name: dsh-turn-rewind
plugins.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。
plugins.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.

plugins.name: ppt-studio
plugins.zh: 为 AI 工作区添加演示文稿制作功能，用户可设计与编辑幻灯片。
plugins.en: Adds presentation creation capabilities to the AI workspace, allowing users to design and edit slides.

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面展示令牌用量热力图、模型细分与账户余额。
plugins.en: Token usage heatmap, per-model breakdowns, and DeepSeek account balance for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (dsh web).

plugins.name: dsh-tool-describe-image
plugins.zh: 通过 DSH 界面提供图像描述工具，实现自动化视觉内容分析。
plugins.en: Provides a tool for describing images via the DSH interface, enabling automated visual content analysis.

plugins.name: dsh-univer-office
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑、检查和交付表格、文档、演示文稿、多维表格和画布，支持实时预览与 worktree 审阅。
plugins.en: Create, edit, inspect, and deliver spreadsheets, documents, presentations, databases, and canvases in DeepSeek Harness, with live preview and worktree review.

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine
plugins.zh: 一个插件让你的dsh可以自由切换你的wallpaper engine里面的壁纸资源，还可以通过多个滑动条来控制透壁纸的模糊程度，亮度，边框，以及对话框的液态玻璃效果，让你的dsh更加美观
plugins.en: Switches Wallpaper Engine wallpapers and adjusts blur, brightness, border, and glass effects for a more polished look.

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.zh: DSH 会话管理插件：删除（回收站恢复/彻底清除）、统计、继续/暂停、打开日志目录、对话顶部抽屉、工作区分组与排序、上下文压缩阈值设置。DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, stats, continue/pause, log folder, hea
plugins.en: Manages DSH sessions with delete, restore, stats, continue, pause, grouping, sorting, and context compaction.

plugins.name: dsh-git-graph
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中呈现可视化 Git 图，方便用户浏览提交历史。
plugins.en: Adds an interactive git graph visualization to the DSH web interface, helping users explore commit history.

plugins.name: dsh-liangshen
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加装饰性陪伴元素，提供趣味互动与视觉点缀。
plugins.en: Adds a decorative companion element to the DSH web interface, providing playful interaction and visual appeal.

plugins.name: dsh-free-search
plugins.zh: 通过 DuckDuckGo 提供免密钥的免费网页搜索，直接在聊天中快速检索互联网信息。
plugins.en: Free web search provider for DeepSeek Harness - DuckDuckGo backend, no API key needed

plugins.name: dsh-skill-explorer
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端提供技能浏览与管理的专用界面。
plugins.en: Provides a dedicated interface for browsing and managing skills within the DSH web client.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成设计工作室，支持可编辑设计与协作流程。
plugins.en: Integrates a design studio into the AI workspace, enabling editable design creation and collaborative workflows.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin
plugins.zh: 支持小说创作与短剧制作，提供专属技能和模板。
plugins.en: Facilitates novel writing and short-drama production with dedicated skills and templates.

plugins.name: dsh-pet
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中引入虚拟宠物，为用户提供趣味互动与视觉陪伴。
plugins.en: Introduces a virtual pet to the DSH web interface, offering playful interactions and visual engagement for users.

plugins.name: whale-girl
plugins.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。
plugins.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.

plugins.name: TokenLedger
plugins.zh: 零配置统计各中转站的 Token 用量与归属，提供使用情况洞察。
plugins.en: Relay-site attributed token usage for DeepSeek Harness — zero config, no credentials

plugins.name: dsh-dream-skin
plugins.zh: DSH Web 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊/渐变/URL）、每用户强调色、主题包导入导出与分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统。
plugins.en: One-command skinning for DSH Web: 8 original themes, wallpaper (opacity/blur/gradient/URL), per-user accent, shareable theme packs, favorites and surprise-me. P

plugins.name: dsh-mnemon
plugins.zh: Mnemon 深度集成：本地三层记忆（Runtime Memory、可检索 Documents、受监督 Memory Spaces）。
plugins.en: Deep Mnemon integration: local three-tier memory (Runtime Memory, retrievable Documents, supervised Memory Spaces).

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。
plugins.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command a

plugins.name: dsh-session-archive
plugins.zh: 归档并存储整个会话，便于日后检索，确保对话历史得以保存和访问。
plugins.en: Archives, stores, and organizes entire sessions for later retrieval, ensuring conversation history is preserved and accessible.

plugins.name: dsh-task-board
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中添加任务看板视图，帮助用户可视化组织与追踪工作项。
plugins.en: Adds a task board view to the DSH web interface, helping users organize and track work items visually.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-subscriptions
plugins.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录，将 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Grok 订阅用作 DeepSeek Harness 的模型提供商，无需 API 密钥。
plugins.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok (X Premium) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers — OAuth login in the web UI, no API keys

plugins.name: dsh-find-plugin
plugins.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。
plugins.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.

plugins.name: superpowers-dsh
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 引入 Superpowers 技能，涵盖测试驱动开发、调试、规划与协作方法。
plugins.en: Superpowers skills for DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers

plugins.name: dsh-skills-manager
plugins.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 的技能，帮助用户组织和运用技能集合。
plugins.en: DSH Skills Manager 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的Skills管理插件

plugins.name: dsh-web-all
plugins.zh: 聚合所有 Web 界面组件，提供全面的界面增强。
plugins.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single package for comprehensive interface enhancement.

plugins.name: dsh-chat-import
plugins.zh: 把 Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode 的聊天记录全保真导入为可续聊的 DSH 会话。
plugins.en: Import Claude Code / Codex / ChatGPT / Cursor / Gemini / Reasonix / opencode chat histories as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy-connect
plugins.zh: 零配置地将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。
plugins.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.

plugins.name: dsh-rewind
plugins.zh: 在会话窗口内原地回退对话，并可选择恢复文件到先前状态。
plugins.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: in-place conversation rewind in the same session window (Claude Code /rewind semantics) + optional file restore

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-pro
plugins.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。
plugins.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cach

plugins.name: dsh-remote-web-ui
plugins.zh: 支持从移动设备远程访问 DSH 网页界面，随时随地控制与监控。
plugins.en: Enables remote access to the DSH web interface from mobile devices, allowing control and monitoring on the go.

plugins.name: dsh-liang-skin
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 滑动变阻器皮肤
plugins.en: A sliding rheostat skin that changes the visual appearance of DeepSeek Harness to resemble a physical dimmer switch.

plugins.name: dsh-reverse-skill
plugins.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 85 个逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究技能的 Cordis 插件。
plugins.en: A DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin that registers 85 reverse-engineering, authorized penetration-testing, and security-research skills.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-hub
plugins.zh: 插件管理面板：已安装插件一键启用/停用，内置 GitHub dsh-plugin 插件市场，支持详情查看与一键安装。
plugins.en: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen
plugins.zh: 提供可安装的多供应商图像生成，支持 Gemini、OpenAI 和 Seedream。
plugins.en: Installable multi-provider image generation bundle for DeepSeek Harness (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Volcengine Seedream)

plugins.name: dsh-auto-mode
plugins.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供安全自动权限管理，在保持安全控制的同时允许自动化操作。
plugins.en: Safe automatic permissions for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-file-upload
plugins.zh: 支持拖拽和回形针上传文件，内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown，并为代理提供 read_document 工具。
plugins.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) file-message plugin: Claude-style drag-and-drop / paperclip upload, content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (with

plugins.name: dsh-session-id
plugins.zh: 在界面中显示或管理当前会话标识。
plugins.en: Displays or manages the current session identifier within the user interface.

plugins.name: deepseek-ippt
plugins.zh: 使用模板和 AI 辅助创建和编辑 PPT 演示文稿。
plugins.en: Creates and edits PPT presentations with templates and AI assistance.

plugins.name: dsh-ai-novel-writer
plugins.zh: 提供本地优先的 AI 小说创作工作台，包含大纲、章节和修订工具。
plugins.en: Provides a local-first AI novel writing workbench with outlines, chapters, and revision tools.

plugins.name: dsh-commandcode-provider
plugins.zh: 将 Command Code 集成进 DSH 作为模型提供商，支持实时模型目录与推理强度。
plugins.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for Command Code: live model catalog, reasoning-effort support, Models-page card. Ported from pi-commandcode-pro

plugins.name: dsh-ego-browser
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无
plugins.en: Integrates the ego-lite Chromium browser into the harness with 13 structured automation tools for semantic interaction, screenshots, CDP control, and task space

plugins.name: dsh-file-review
plugins.zh: 展示代理更改文件的差异，辅助审查修改内容。
plugins.en: a dsh plugin - review  files that an agent just changed,you can see the diff

plugins.name: dsh-tavern
plugins.zh: DSH 酒馆插件：DeepSeek Harness 原生管理面板（多角色卡/多世界书/可切换预设）。使用/安装：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavern
plugins.en: Manages role cards, world books, and presets for multi-character roleplay sessions in a native panel.

plugins.name: dsh-ssh
plugins.zh: 通过 DSH 网页界面实现远程 Shell 访问与命令执行，便于系统管理。
plugins.en: Enables remote shell access and command execution through the DSH web interface, facilitating system management.

plugins.name: dsh-usage
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聚合多种界面增强与工具插件的 Web 生态包，通过创意工坊分发。
plugins.en: A web plugin ecosystem pack for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating various UI enhancements and tools via a creative workshop distribution channel.

plugins.name: dsh-web-settings
plugins.zh: 提供设置面板，让用户自定义 Web 界面偏好和选项。
plugins.en: Provides a settings panel for users to customize web UI preferences and options.

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.zh: 管理聊天会话，包括创建、切换和删除。
plugins.en: Manages chat sessions, including creation, switching, and deletion.

plugins.name: dsh-pet
plugins.zh: DSH Web UI 桌宠：25 组透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击互动与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成流水线。
plugins.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.

plugins.name: dsh-skins
plugins.zh: 为桌面客户端应用视觉皮肤和主题，改变其外观。
plugins.en: Applies visual skins and themes to the desktop client, changing its appearance.

plugins.name: DSH-Plugins-Marketplace
plugins.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web界面中浏览、安装和更新所有GitHub dsh-plugin插件。
plugins.en: DSH插件市场 / DSH Plugin Marketplace: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中一键浏览、安装与更新 GitHub topic:dsh-plugin 的全部插件 | browse, install & update all GitHub dsh-plugin plugins

plugins.name: dsh-reasoning-effort
plugins.zh: DSH适用的Codex风格的思考强度滑块，以及大肥鱼跑步滑块。Codex-style model and reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.en: A slider control for adjusting reasoning effort and model settings in DeepSeek Harness, styled after Codex, including a fun running slider.

plugins.name: dsh-notification
plugins.zh: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。
